source.kind: the value site the Club Manager bake reads (player_market_values is Transfermarkt shaped)

method: Each club's Transfermarkt 26/27 detailed squad page (kader, plus/1, season 26/27 selected on the page) was read on 2026-10-06 and every Round 1034 ledger row was matched to it by its Transfermarkt player id, never by name.

valueEur is the page's market value as printed (EUR 450k is 450000). A dash on the page is null: the player has no value there and is NOT given one; the generator gives him the curve's floor and lists him in noValue.
tmPosition is the page's detailed position. The generator maps it through the bake's position map; where it disagrees with the ledger's two source group, the group wins.

Values convert to USD at the house rate (scripts/lib/cmValueCurve.mjs, EUR 1 = USD 1.08, the rate scripts/data/defensiveMidfield2026.json records) and to a rating on the bake's own curve, both imported, never copied.
